items.source: BeansException - in case of creation errors
items.translation: BeansException - 在创建错误时

items.source: customFilter - a custom type filter for selecting beans among the raw bean type matches (or UNFILTERED for all raw type matches without any default filtering)
items.translation: `customFilter` - 用于在原始 bean 类型匹配中选择 bean 的自定义类型过滤器（或为所有原始类型匹配且无默认过滤选择 `UNFILTERED`）

items.source: Return a custom-filtered Stream over all matching object instances, pre-ordered according to the factory's common order comparator.
items.translation: 返回一个针对所有匹配对象实例进行自定义过滤的 Stream，并按照工厂的通用顺序比较器预先排序。

items.source: Return a custom-filtered Stream over all matching object instances, without specific ordering guarantees (but typically in registration order).
items.translation: 返回一个针对所有匹配对象实例的自定义过滤的 Stream，不提供特定的排序保证（但通常在注册顺序中）。

items.source: Note: The result may be filtered by default according to qualifiers on the injection point versus target beans and the general autowire candidate status of matching beans. For custom filtering against type-matching candidates, use stream(Predicate) instead (potentially with UNFILTERED).
items.translation: 注意：结果可能会根据注入点与目标 Bean 上的限定符以及匹配 Bean 的一般自动装配候选状态进行默认过滤。若要针对类型匹配的候选项进行自定义过滤，请使用stream(Predicate)（可能需要配合使用UNFILTERED）。

items.source: Note that getObject() never returns null - it will throw a NoSuchBeanDefinitionException instead -, whereas getIfAvailable() will return null if no matching bean is present at all. However, both methods will throw a NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException if more than one matching bean is found without a clear unique winner (see below). Last but not least, getIfUnique() will return null both when no matching bean is found and when more than one matching bean is found without a unique winner.
items.translation: 请注意，getObject() 永远不会返回 null——如果找不到匹配的 Bean 定义，它会抛出 NoSuchBeanDefinitionException；而 getIfAvailable() 则会在完全不存在匹配 Bean 的情况下返回 null。然而，如果找到多个匹配的 Bean 且没有明确的唯一胜出者（见下文），这两种方法都会抛出 NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException。最后但同样重要的是，getIfUnique() 在找不到匹配 Bean 或找到多个匹配 Bean 且没有唯一胜出者时，都会返回 null。

items.source: As of 5.1, this interface extends Iterable and provides Stream support. It can be therefore be used in for loops, provides Iterable.forEach(Consumer) iteration and allows for collection-style stream() access.
items.translation: 自 5.1 版本起，此接口扩展了Iterable并提供Stream支持。因此，它可用于for循环，提供Iterable.forEach(Consumer)迭代，并允许集合风格的stream()访问。

items.source: As of 6.2, this interface declares default implementations for all methods. This makes it easier to implement in a custom fashion, for example, for unit tests. For typical purposes, implement stream() to enable all other methods. Alternatively, you may implement the specific methods that your callers expect, for example, just getObject() or getIfAvailable().
items.translation: 自 6.2 版本起，该接口为所有方法声明了默认实现。这使得以自定义方式（例如用于单元测试）实现它变得更加容易。对于典型用途，只需实现 stream() 即可启用所有其他方法。或者，您也可以实现调用者期望的具体方法，例如仅实现 getObject() 或 getIfAvailable()。

items.source: The default method applies an OrderComparator to the stream() method. You may override this to apply an AnnotationAwareOrderComparator if necessary.
items.translation: 默认方法对 OrderComparator 应用于 stream() 方法。如有必要，您可以覆盖此方法以应用 AnnotationAwareOrderComparator。

items.source: In a BeanFactory environment, every ObjectProvider obtained from the factory will be bound to its BeanFactory for a specific bean type, matching all provider calls against factory-registered bean definitions. Note that all such calls dynamically operate on the underlying factory state, freshly resolving the requested target object on every call.
items.translation: 在 `BeanFactory` 环境中，从工厂获取的每个 `ObjectProvider` 都将绑定到其特定的 bean 类型的 `BeanFactory`，并将所有提供者调用与工厂注册的 bean 定义进行匹配。请注意，所有这些调用都会动态操作底层工厂状态，并在每次调用时重新解析请求的目标对象。

items.source: In a standard Spring application context, this will be ordered according to Ordered conventions, and in case of annotation-based configuration also considering the Order annotation, analogous to multi-element injection points of list/array type.
items.translation: 在标准的 Spring 应用程序上下文中，这将按照 Ordered 约定进行排序，并且在基于注解的配置的情况下，还会考虑 Order 注解，类似于列表或数组类型的多元素注入点。

items.source: Allows for specifying explicit construction arguments, along the lines of BeanFactory.getBean(String, Object...).
items.translation: 允许指定显式构造参数，类似于BeanFactory.getBean(String, Object...)。

items.source:
Uniqueness is generally up to the container's candidate resolution algorithm
but always honors the "primary" flag (with only one of the candidate beans marked
as primary) and the "fallback" flag (with only one of the candidate beans not
marked as fallback). The default-candidate flag is consistently taken into
account as well, even for non-annotation-based injection points, with a single
default candidate winning in case of no clear primary/fallback indication.
items.translation: 唯一性通常由容器的候选解析算法决定，但始终遵循"primary"（主）标志（仅有一个候选 Bean 被标记为主）和"fallback"（回退）标志（仅有一个候选 Bean 未被标记为回退）。默认候选标志也会被一致地考虑在内，即使对于非基于注解的注入点也是如此；在没有明确的主/回退指示的情况下，单个默认候选将胜出。

A predicate for unfiltered type matches, including non-default candidates
but still excluding non-autowire candidates when used on injection points.
items.translation: 用于未过滤类型匹配的谓词，包括非默认候选者，但在应用于注入点时仍排除非自动装配候选者。
